result.title: PointNeXt Adapter Improved Model for BIM Component Defect Association under Construction Images and Design Model Attributes
result.summary: Construction site defect analysis increasingly requires linking field evidence to the correct BIM object, because a crack, spalling area, missing sleeve or misaligned support is useful for quality control only when it is connected with component identity, location, responsibility and design intent. This paper proposes a PointNeXt Adapter improved model for BIM component defect association under construction images and design model attributes. The method aligns site image crops, local point cloud patches, BIM component identifiers, geometry attributes, material categories, installation stage, inspection distance, viewpoint quality and source reliability tags into component level inspection windows. PointNeXt learns local geometry and deviation from as built point evidence, while the adapter injects BIM attributes so the same geometric irregularity can be interpreted differently for structural, envelope, MEP and embedded components. The fusion head outputs component link, defect class, defect probability, confidence, dominant evidence and recommended review action. A synthetic multisource BIM inspection dataset is used to evaluate repeated layouts, occlusion, sparse point clouds, registration errors and unseen component arrangements. Results show that attribute aware point learning improves association accuracy, defect recall and confidence calibration compared with image only, point only, simple fusion and adapter free baselines. The framework is positioned as traceable BIM issue review support, requiring manual confirmation and staged field validation before operational deployment.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PointNeXt Adapter 模型，把现场图像裁剪、局部点云块与 BIM 构件标识、几何属性、材料、施工阶段、视角质量等对齐到构件级检查窗口，由适配器注入 BIM 属性以区分不同构件类型下的几何异常，最终输出构件关联、缺陷类别与置信度、主证据及复核建议，并在合成多源数据集上测试遮挡、稀疏点云与配准误差等情形。
AI.relevance_reason: 「属性条件化的特征融合」使同一几何异常在不同构件语义下得到不同解释，可供核查其是否可借鉴为 LVR 中先验或任务信息对内部视觉状态的调制与证据筛选；但原论文面向施工缺陷审查应用，不涉及 latent 推理状态生成或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 机制，联系较弱。
